validation.scope: The ring tests submit synthetic fixture geometry/resources through Vulkan 1.1. The selected-draw dump and magenta readback are test fixtures, not retail parity evidence.

trace_observation.smoke_harness_log_capture: Plugin REXLOG trace records were not surfaced in the smoke harness output; the harness verifies ring consumption but not the logger sink. A P1 retail run is needed to confirm records and correlate the live guest WPTR.
trace_observation.retail_trace: The first two P1 retail runs used the earlier 8,192-record DSO and exhausted its cap before the menu_background.xml probes. A third run loaded the 32,768-record build, received CP_RB_WPTR=5651, and the worker consumed the range containing it.

nearby_guest_event.event: two failed probes of D:\tracks\_data\instances\scenes\menu_background.xml and two of D:\tracks\_data\static\scenes\menu_background.xml

first_p1_retail_trace.interpretation: The trace cap was reached 3.506 seconds before the menu_background.xml probes. It proves WPTR notifications and normal packet snapshot/expansion earlier in this run, but does not establish whether WPTR 5651 reached the plugin at the later transition. The log continued to record Copy/Convert operations through 22:53:31.121.
first_p1_retail_trace.process_state_at_inspection: The retail process was still alive. It was not stopped or modified by Process 2.

second_p1_retail_trace.interpretation: The second run repeated the cap exhaustion with the same old 8,192-record plugin path. The guest reached the same menu_background.xml missing-file probes; it did not exercise the 32,768-record build. The old DSO was preserved separately and the canonical handover path was updated only after the process exited.

presenter_refresh_failures_before_wptr_5.error: mixed 4x-to-1x depth/stencil preservation requires a provider-confirmed enabled resolve capability

worker_consumed_range_containing_5651.snapshot: rptr=5645 wptr=5657; snapshot-ok=true; batch-bytes=48; expand-ok=true; packets=83

ring_activity_after_probes.interpretation: Ring trace activity continued about 0.924 seconds after the last XML miss. The log then has no further ring trace before Window closing at 23:00:51.875 and Title terminated at 23:00:52.076; this does not establish why the guest later stopped or closed.

capture.observation: A very dark disclaimer screen with faint text; no menu or cutscene is visible.

third_p1_retail_trace.interpretation: This confirms the cap-32768 plugin received CP_RB_WPTR=5651 and its worker consumed a snapshot whose [RPTR,WPTR) range contains it. It verifies ring delivery and packet expansion for this run, not downstream scene rendering, why the menu asset probes failed, or retail graphics parity.

p1_correlation_target.third_run_result: Confirmed in the third run: CP_RB_WPTR new=5651 was trace record 8395, and the worker later consumed [5645,5657), which includes that pointer. This run used a different process instance than the earlier guest snapshot, so it confirms the plugin path and pointer value but does not correlate the old snapshot to the third run.

resolve_capable_trace_followup_build.purpose: Combine the current P2 ring tracing build with the provider-confirmed depth/stencil resolve capability that the third retail run lacked.
resolve_capable_trace_followup_build.retail_status: Built and validation-tested; no retail recapture with this candidate has been observed yet.
